Name: Custom NPC - The Man in the Painting English Translation
Author: Cielestia
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52636][b][u]ORIGINAL TEXT FROM MOD[/u][/b][/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52636][/url]


【Background & Lore】 An unsigned painting hangs on the museum wall. Inside is a man with his eyes gently closed—nameless, with no known past. The label beside the frame reads simply: "Do not touch the artwork." Yet, if you visit often enough, you might notice those words slowly becoming something not meant for everyone to see. He has no shadow. He cannot accept bouquets, movie tickets, or Mermaid's Pendants. All he ever gives you are unsigned letters—and an exhibition label that gradually stops acting like one.

【Instructions & Features】
[list]
[*][b]Requirements:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore [/url]& [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture [/url]/ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits [/url](for high-resolution portraits).[/*]
[*][b]Unlock Mechanism:[/b] Unlocks on Spring 10, Year 1 (you will receive a letter from Gunther). Once unlocked, he remains in the game permanently without needing to be re-triggered in subsequent years. Before this date, the painting will not appear, and the character remains inactive.[/*]
[*][b]Schedule & Routine:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]06:00 – 16:00:[/b] Located inside the museum painting.[/*]
[*][b]After 16:00:[/b] The character vanishes from the frame (this is intentional, NOT a bug) and moves to the area near the Pelican Town bridge.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Interactions:[/b] The primary storyline and dialogue are hidden within the label next to the painting—clicking on the painting is highly recommended (the text changes as friendship increases). Regular dialogue and gifting are only available after 16:00 near the bridge.[/*]
[*][b]Relationship Limits:[/b] Friendship caps at 10 hearts. Non-romanceable, non-marriageable.[/*]
[*][b]Language:[/b] Currently available only in Chinese.[/*]
[/list]
【Character & MOD Design】
[list]
[*][b]About the Name:[/b] His concept name is "Kui" (傀), but in-game, his name is displayed purely as — ? —
. No one in town calls him by name.[/*]
[*][b]Design Concept:[/b] This MOD was created as a small experiment to test a "non-physical entity" NPC concept. It focuses on subtle text exploration and hidden easter eggs rather than functioning as a standard companion NPC.[/*]
[*][b]Schedule Restrictions:[/b] He has no birthday, does not attend festivals (e.g., Feast of the Winter Star), and never visits Ginger Island. Aside from the museum, he only frequents the Pelican Town bridge.[/*]
[/list]
[b][i][u][s]Message from me[/s][/u][/i][/b]
[b]Its basic English translation, it will be updated with better grammar soonish :3 [/b]
